verdict.rationale: BugSnag's official bugsnag-js SDK automatically detects errors in the browser, Node.js and React Native, with framework plugins for React, Vue, Angular, Express, Restify and Koa. The docs cite error reporting libraries for over 50 platforms, and a hands-on community report confirms native iOS, Android, Ruby and Node libraries, with the iOS one auto-reporting fatal errors. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of automatic uncaught-error capture for native mobile and non-JS backend SDKs (the hands-on corroboration is an old community thread).

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my web frontend, backend services, and mobile apps with official SDKs that capture uncaught errors automatically

citations.quote: Automatically detect JavaScript errors in the browser, Node.js and React Native, with plugins for React, Vue, Angular, Express, Restify and Koa.
BugSnag provides error reporting libraries for over 50 different platforms
The iOS library had a nice interface, would take minutes to add, and auto-reports fatal errors.
